description:
FOUND s473t6c (#1501 ROUND 10).

t/op/signame_canonical.t plans `scalar @duplicate_signals * 5` rows from the
signal names %Config lists twice (CHLD/CLD, POLL/IO, ABRT/IOT on Linux), and for
each pair it does:
    local $SIG{$dupe} = \&handler_is;
    is($SIG{$dupe}, $SIG{$canonical_name}, "Both handlers ... are set");
    kill $dupe, $$;  kill $canonical_name, $$;   # the handler asserts the name
    # then, after the local scope: both are undef again
PCL produces NO TAP AT ALL, and the runner records no aborted form.

NOT the cause (measured s473t6c): %Config has `sig_name` and `sig_num` here, so
`@duplicate_signals` is computable and `plan tests => 15` is reachable.

So the file stops somewhere between `watchdog(25)` and its first `is`.  Start by
running it under `tools/runt` and reading stderr; the candidates are
`watchdog()` (it forks a process that kills the parent after N seconds),
`$SIG{$name}` assignment by NAME through a `local`, and `kill NAME, $$` (a
SIGNAL NAME rather than a number).

Related: #1928 (%SIG lookups are not NUL-clean, op/sigdispatch.t).
subject: op/signame_canonical.t produces ZERO rows: the duplicate-signal-name handler matrix never reaches its first assertion (15 shortfall rows)
